papers.title: Rainfall-induced mechanisms of soil-rock interface shallow landslides: Insights from field monitoring and CFD-DEM modeling
papers.authors: Chen X, Shen Y et al.
papers.angle: Combines field monitoring with coupled fluid-particle simulation to show how rainfall drives shallow failures at soil-rock interfaces, useful for slope screening and early-warning design.

papers.title: Numerical and experimental study of swirl grouting penetration in sandy soils with random porosity
papers.authors: Tang L, Liang W et al.
papers.angle: Examines how natural porosity variability controls swirl grout spread in sand, offering guidance for planning jet grouting treatments and anticipating uneven penetration on site.

papers.title: A Comparison of Tensile Testing Techniques and Predictive Correlations
papers.authors: Lindenbach EJ, Foran JR et al.
papers.angle: Compares direct and indirect rock tensile tests and their correlations, helping engineers judge which method to specify for dam foundation strength and how much to trust inferred values.

papers.title: Settlement behavior and reinforcement effect of subgrades filled with recycled Aggregate–Loess mixture
papers.authors: Mei Y, Zhou Z et al.
papers.angle: Demonstrates that recycled aggregate and loess blends can reduce subgrade settlement with reinforcement, offering a lower-carbon fill option for road embankments.

papers.title: MEMS-embedded smart segments for shield tunnel monitoring from manufacture to operation
papers.authors: Feng H, Zhang D et al.
papers.angle: Embeds sensors in shield tunnel segments from manufacture through operation, giving owners continuous lining condition data that practitioners can use for maintenance and performance checks.

papers.title: Evaluating and predicting interlayer bond behavior of RCC pavements using multiple testing methods and machine learning approaches
papers.angle: Compares several interlayer bond tests for roller-compacted concrete pavements and predicts bond with machine learning, helping engineers choose tests and anticipate delamination risk.

papers.title: Geotextile reinforcement for protecting buried pipelines: Experimental evaluation of reinforcement geometry and pipe response
papers.angle: Experimentally shows how geotextile layout around buried pipes reduces load and deformation, giving designers practical geometry guidance for pipeline protection.

papers.title: Next 24 h rockburst probabilistic warning using microseismic monitoring and machine learning
papers.authors: Li X, Xu N et al.
papers.angle: Forecasts rockburst probability over the next day from microseismic data using machine learning, offering a practical warning tool for deep mining and tunnelling crews.

papers.title: A Rock Creep Damage Model Considering the Influence of the Free-Energy Function
papers.authors: Liu W, Zhang S, Zhao S
papers.angle: Adds energy-based damage coupling to creep modelling, which may help engineers extrapolate long-term rock deformation for deep tunnels and dam foundations more reliably than classical element models.

papers.title: A probabilistic spatiotemporal framework for landslide hazard assessment
papers.authors: Qin S, Zhang C et al.
papers.angle: Offers a space-time probabilistic approach to landslide hazard that could support regional susceptibility mapping and risk-based land-use decisions for practitioners.

papers.title: A 3D Implementation of an Elastoviscoplastic Model and Application to Creep-Driven Slow-Moving Landslides
papers.authors: Insana A, Campana F, Barla M
papers.angle: Presents a 3D time-dependent soil model for creeping slopes and discusses calibration challenges, helpful for engineers assessing slope movements threatening structures and utilities.

papers.title: Kinematic simulation of rockfall and dynamic response analysis of bridge structures: A case study of a rockfall-bridge impact event
papers.authors: Bao H, Zhu J et al.
papers.angle: Links a rockfall event to dynamic bridge response through a real case, giving engineers a practical workflow for assessing impact risk to transport structures below rock slopes.

papers.title: Stochastic evolution of underlying tunnel deformation driven by inverse consolidation in spatially variable quasi-saturated clay
papers.authors: Xiao-Qian Z, Ming-Guang L et al.
papers.angle: Shows how spatially variable clay consolidation can produce uncertain settlement of existing tunnels, relevant when assessing ground movement impacts from nearby excavation or dewatering.

papers.title: A knowledge-driven collaborative-design model for drill-and-blast tunnel support enhanced by large language model
papers.authors: Kou X, Li X et al.
papers.angle: Proposes language-model support for selecting drill-and-blast tunnel support, which could speed up design reviews if validated against established rock mass classification practice.

papers.title: Numerical simulation of wicking nonwoven geotextiles embedded in unsaturated soil subgrade
papers.authors: Jarjour J, Ibrahim A, Meguid MA
papers.angle: Models how wicking geotextiles move water in unsaturated subgrades, helping designers assess whether such drainage layers can improve moisture control and pavement durability.

papers.title: Effects of Mesoscale Fracture Networks on Injection-Induced Slip and Seismicity in Fault Systems During CO2 Geological Storage
papers.authors: Ma H, Li P et al.
papers.angle: Shows how fracture networks control slip and seismicity when injecting CO2, informing induced-seismicity risk assessment for geological storage projects.

papers.title: A Unified Pipe Network Model for coupled thermo-hydraulic transport in frozen fractured rock: Formulation, validation and application
papers.angle: Introduces a pipe network model for heat and water flow in frozen fractured rock, relevant to engineers designing ground freezing or cold-region rock projects and checking thermal behaviour.
